message.content: I have the filing data, quote, and account state. Apple's FY2023 fundamentals support a modest starter position within the mandate.
message.reasoning:

Place order: buy 22 shares at limit 222.72.

Key figures: revenue FY2023 383285, net income 96995, eps_diluted 6.13, operating_income 114301, operating_cash_flow 110543. Maybe also FY2022 revenue to note the decline. I'll include both years.
